items.question: Where did Myisha Hines-Allen play college basketball?
items.answer: Myisha Hines-Allen played four seasons at Louisville, averaging 14.3 points and 8.1 rebounds. She was the 2016 ACC Player of the Year and set Louisville's single-season rebounding record with 373 in 2018.

items.question: Who is Myisha Hines-Allen?
items.answer: Myisha Hines-Allen is a WNBA forward who won the 2019 championship with the Washington Mystics and made the All-WNBA Second Team in 2020. Washington drafted her 19th overall in 2018.
